values.headline: FoldX predicts ΔΔG -1.04 kcal/mol for H101R, below the destabilising threshold of 2.0 kcal/mol (residue pLDDT 97.0).

controls: Within-site comparison: the same predictor for the other substitutions reported at this residue.
Applicability control: the model confidence (pLDDT) at the residue, because FoldX on a low-confidence region is not interpretable.
limitations: FoldX on a predicted model is a computational prediction with errors near 1 kcal/mol.
A neutral stability prediction does not show the variant is tolerated.
reproducible_command: ORPHAFOLD_API_URL=http://localhost:8000 PYTHONPATH=lab/tools lab/.venv/bin/python -m orphafold_lab_tools.experiments stability_effect --accession P04839 --position 101 --alternate-residue R --reference-residue H --gene CYBB --variant-id CYBB-p.His101Arg
